content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing a startup issue with a [product_name]. Upon starting, I see the message: 'TEST MODE' followed by 'AUTO TEST' and 'WELCOME'. However, pressing the buttons has no effect. Can anyone assist with this problem? This was split from a thread discussing [product_name] and related modules versus [product_name] [version_no].
You can create a Support Request; your first one is complimentary. Afterwards, [company_name] will reach out to you.
Thread closed as the question was posted twice. The other thread with the subject '[product_name] error' was published within the same conference. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user reports that their [product_name] remains stuck in 'TEST MODE' during startup and does not respond to button presses, preventing normal use of the device.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the device to start correctly and respond to button inputs, allowing access to menus or standard functions.
